title: The CA Gate on the Bank CFO Chair
subtitle: HDFC Bank’s December handover, the 28 November 2025 Governance Directions, and a composite housing-finance decision three days before the October MPC
description: HBS-style teaching case for 2 October 2026. HDFC Bank appointed Puneet Sharma CFO from 1 December 2026, designate from 1 September, and said he meets the RBI Commercial Banks — Governance Directions, 2025. The public-sector minimum is a chartered accountant with 15 years, 10 in banks or FIs, 5 at senior management. A labelled composite housing-finance firm must choose whether to rent that profile, build it, or split the signature.
sources: RBI (28 November 2025). Commercial Banks — Governance Directions, 2025, RBI/DOR/2025-26/149.
Business Standard (30 June 2026). Sharma appointed HDFC Bank CFO from 1 December 2026; designate from 1 September; meets the 2025 Directions.
Business Standard and Mint (29 June 2026). Axis and Bandhan CFO exits. Mantri last day 25 September 2026.
Reuters (5 August 2026). Repo held at 5.25%. FY27 GDP estimate 6.7%. Inflation forecast 5%.
RBI calendar. Next MPC meeting 5–7 October 2026.
